historical_result.preceding_snapshot: Step 3 listed the Profile link after opening the account menu.

diagnostic_contract.action_scope: frozen actions 1-3, then read-only target geometry at 0, 2 and 5 seconds; no profile-link click

reviewed_cause.mechanism_zh: 原轨迹打开 Reddit 账号菜单后，快照列出 Profile 链接，但随后的 :visible 点击超时。相同动作前缀下，官方 Moli 1.1.6 中该链接存在且样式可见，页面已加载完成，布局矩形仍持续五秒为零；固定候选中矩形为 127×35。因此目标不是缺失或单纯等待不足，而是菜单更新后可见性所依赖的布局几何未刷新，符合已复现的脏布局快照故障家族。
reviewed_cause.mechanism_en: After the original trajectory opened Reddit's account menu, its snapshot listed the Profile link but the following :visible click timed out. After the same action prefix, official Moli 1.1.6 contained the link with visible computed style and a complete page, yet its rectangle stayed zero for five seconds; the fixed candidate gave it a 127×35 rectangle. The target was neither absent nor merely awaiting page load. Visibility depended on geometry not refreshed after the menu update, consistent with the reproduced dirty-layout-snapshot defect family.

scope_limit: This is a same-page 1.1.6-versus-fixed geometry probe on the current Rainbond site, not a formal 1.1.3 rerun or a commit-level bisect. The historical official score remains unchanged.
